description: Watch an IOTA mainnet address or IOTA name in a loop and get only new transactions since your last call: direction, IOTA amount, status, time and explorer link, plus the current balance. First call returns recent transactions and a cursor; pass the cursor back on the next call. For deposit detection, treasury and whale watching. Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"address":"0x74b8312393d50952c9a90bad5c9098c7c5da20f0832a22ed1ce8265524ab3df4","limit":3}.
